# Bryan Zhao 

 

## Bryan Zhao

### Tenure

2023 – Present

### Title

Product Designer

### Signature

 Bryan Bochen Zhao (Chinese: 赵博晨; pinyin: Zhào Bóchén) is a Chinese Hot Wheels designer who has worked at Mattel since 2024; he initially worked at Mattel as a vehicle design intern in 2023. Prior to this he held internship opportunities at BYD while at ArtCenter College of Design.
